First public release of Arede Grotesk, the typeface of the Arede brand.

**What's in the box:** `AredeGrotesk-Regular` as OTF (desktop), TTF and WOFF2 (web), plus the license.

**Install:** double-click the OTF on macOS or the TTF on Windows. Web use and CDN link in the [README](https://github.com/aredebr/arede-grotesk#use-on-the-web).

**Version 1.0** redesigns the lowercase core from the arede wordmark (a r e d exact; b c f h i m n o p q u derived; k l j adjusted) and inherits every other glyph from Space Grotesk 2.0.0. Details in the [CHANGELOG](https://github.com/aredebr/arede-grotesk/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md).
